summary: Implement the RegExp-side Symbol.replace protocol including captures, replacement tokens, functional replacers, global iteration, and lastIndex behavior.

target.notes: The builtin hook repeatedly uses RegExpExec when global, performs Unicode-aware empty-match advancement, and applies ECMAScript GetSubstitution or callable replacement semantics.

caveats: String.prototype.replace owns initial Symbol.replace dispatch; this rule owns the builtin RegExp hook implementation.
.NET Regex.Replace replacement-token grammar is not equivalent to JavaScript.
